How it works

Get your book featured, in four steps

No travel and no stress. Everything happens by message, at your pace.

1

Say hello

Send your book title, genre and a link to where it is sold, by email or WhatsApp.

2

Share your details

Tell us about your book, your genre and your readers.

3

We write the summary

We prepare a clear summary based on your Amazon page and send it for your approval.

4

Go live

Your book page goes live with your cover, summary and a link for readers to buy.

How the Ember Edition works

Every book in the Ember Library comes dressed for the holidays: a ribbon, a gold seal and a festive cover, ready to be wrapped and given.

  1. Pick a bookBrowse the rows or search by title, author or mood.
  2. See it dressedOpen a book to see its Christmas Edition, with the ribbon, seal and a note on who it suits.
  3. Give itBuy it on Amazon as a gift, or share it with a friend first.

For authors: join the Ember Library

What’s included

  • Your 3D cover in the Ember Library rows
  • Your own Christmas Edition page, with ribbon, seal and festive dress
  • A “Perfect gift for…” label that tells readers who to give it to
  • A buy button to your store page and a share button for readers

How a book qualifies

  • It is published, with a store link readers can buy from
  • It has a finished cover
  • It would make a good winter or Christmas gift. Any genre can apply.

About Bookelpbase

Bookelpbase is an independent literary discovery platform created to support authors and make discovering remarkable books easier for readers.

We understand that writing a book takes creativity, dedication and commitment. However, getting that book noticed by the right audience can be another challenge.

That is where Bookelpbase comes in.

Our platform provides opportunities for authors to introduce their books through thoughtfully presented features, author interviews and book spotlights.

We aim to create a welcoming space where writers can share their journeys, readers can discover interesting titles, and great stories can receive more attention.

Our goal is simple: to help bring authors and readers closer, one story at a time.

Get featured

What We Do

Book Features

We showcase selected books, highlighting their descriptions, themes, genres and unique appeal.

Featured Books

We introduce authors, their backgrounds, creative journeys and published works.

Book Summaries

We write clear summaries based on each book’s Amazon page, so readers know what to expect.

Literary Discovery

We help readers explore different authors, genres and stories they may not have discovered otherwise.

Our Promise

At Bookelpbase, we believe every story deserves an opportunity to be discovered.

We are committed to presenting books thoughtfully, celebrating the creativity of authors and creating a welcoming experience for readers.

Bookelpbase · Connecting Authors, Books and Readers.

Our Mission

Our mission is to support authors by creating opportunities for book discovery, meaningful exposure and stronger connections with readers.

Our Vision

To become a trusted destination where authors can showcase their creativity, readers can discover remarkable stories, and books from different genres can find new audiences.
